title: Fake military UFO letter used to test Bill Moore
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Fake military UFO letter used to test Bill Moore, about c. 1979-1980 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: basically he got a letter that was sent to AppPro and Appro looked at it and said, "Well, why don't you check this out?"

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a writer named Greg Bishop retells what a UFO researcher named Bill Moore told him about the years around 1979 and 1980. According to Bishop, a letter that looked like it came from the military was sent to APRO, a civilian UFO research group, and the group passed it to Moore to look into, but the letter was fake and was used to test him. If true, it would mean someone was setting traps to see how UFO researchers would react.
